Product:{\"sku\":\"7100100149\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Step into the shoes of a transfer student thrust into an unexpected fate when entering the hour ""hidden"" between one day and the next. Awaken an incredible power and chase the mysteries of the Dark Hour, fight for your friends, and leave a mark on their memories forever.

Persona 3 Reload is a captivating reimagining of the genre-defining RPG, reborn for the modern era.

Key Features:
- An emotional and gripping journey – Fully immerse yourself into a story of life and death with new scenes, character interactions, and additional voiceover.

- Forge meaningful bonds – Choose how to spend each day through various activities from exploring the Port Island to forging genuine bonds with unforgettable characters, shaping your journey through every interaction.

- Explore the ever-changing Tartarus – Battle your way through this mysterious labyrinth, where each visit presents new layouts and challenges as you climb closer to the truth.

- Master deep, strategic combat – Build your ideal team and take on otherworldly Shadows in turn-based battles that demand tactical thinking.

- Unleash the power of Persona Fusion – Customize your team and create powerful new Personas to aid you in battle.

- Experience a stylish, modernized faithful remake – Dive into a world brought to life with cutting-edge graphics, sleek UI, quality-of-life updates, and an unforgettable soundtrack.
